items.title: Ray Shiner interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 11, 1998
items.q: They had the wrong booking agent, Willard Alexander, who was used to booking dance bands

ctx.x: Yeah. These guys wanted to do it anyway.

Yeah. They had the wrong booking agent, Willard Alexander, who was used to booking dance bands, and we were not a dance band, we were a concert band for listening. You could dance to us, because Eddie and Bill wrote arrangements which were conducive to dancing, but it was very puzzling to the audience because the melody used to shift from one section to the next or a different combination of instruments. We’d get to a gig and the people would yell up to the bandstand, “Why don’t you play something we can dance…
Yeah? Did they play with the band also?
